---
name: API request
about: The frontend needs data or an action the API doesn't have yet
title: "API: <what the screen needs>"
labels: api-request
---

<!-- One need per issue. Check docs/api/ENDPOINTS.md first — many lists already take filters. -->

**Screen / feature**
<!-- Which page or component, and what the user is trying to do. Link the design if there is one. -->

**What it needs to read**
<!-- Fields you need back, e.g. client name, latest CSR spent, number of open tasks. Say "list" or "one record". -->

**Filters, sort, paging**
<!-- e.g. filter by status and BU, sort by updated date, 25 per page. -->

**What it needs to change** (if any)
<!-- Create / update / delete — which fields, which are required, any rules (e.g. "date can't be in the past"). -->

**Who may see / do it**
<!-- Everyone signed in? Only their own records? Managers? Super admin? -->

**Closest existing endpoint** (if any)
<!-- e.g. GET /api/clients — "same, plus X". -->

**Example** (optional)
<!-- A sample request / the JSON you'd like back. -->

**Needed by**
<!-- Date, or "nice to have". -->
